none: PAS HAMP-8C4DD6: Roman coin : Republican denarius struck under Mark Antony
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman Republican denarius of Mark Antony dating to 32-31 BC, struck by a travelling mint. The reverse depicts a legionary eagle between two standards and the legend LEG III, for Legio 3. To the obverse is a galley with a possible counterstamp 'M' above. Reference: RRC 544/15.
